news.body: Another tropical system is making its way toward the Central Pacific, but the overall setup is shaping up to be far more manageable in terms of severe wind. Tropical Depression 2C—expected to organize into Tropical Storm Moke—is running into atmospheric speed bumps that will keep it from building into a major hurricane. Moderate upper-level wind shear and pockets of dry air are tilting the system and disrupting its convective core. While the system won’t pack a damaging wind punch, its broad footprint means it will act like a giant, moisture-rich sponge moving across the region.

news.headline: Europe Battles Extreme Weather: France, Spain, Serbia & Bosnia Hit By Wildfires, Floods And Storms
news.body: Extreme weather is gripping multiple European nations as severe wildfires, flash floods and powerful storms force thousands of people to evacuate. France is battling a major wildfire across the Cap Ferret Peninsula in the southwest, where extreme summer heat and months of drought have created dangerous fire conditions. Authorities ordered the evacuation of the popular tourism hotspot as flames threatened homes and the peninsula’s main escape route. More than 10,000 hectares of forest have reportedly been affected, while around 63,000 people, including large numbers of tourists, were forced to leave the area. Boats and emergency teams were deployed as authorities worked to protect residents and visitors. Spain is also facing a contrasting weather crisis, with intense wildfires occurring alongside torrential rainfall and flash flooding. Heavy rains disrupted road and rail transport and injured more than 11 people.

The death toll from the magnitude 7.7 earthquake near Ende, Indonesia has risen to at least 38, with dozens injured and many buildings collapsed or damaged. Rescuers are searching for survivors in affected areas, and tsunami waves of less than 1 meter were recorded in several locations before the warning was lifted.

Many rushed from their homes, but there were no initial reports of damage from the quake, which was felt strongly for around one minute in regions such as Nagekeo and Bima, said Dodi Yuleova, the spokesperson for the national disaster mitigation agency. A video on Facebook, verified by Reuters as located at a port in Maumere, the main town in Sikka Regency on Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, showed parts of a building collapsing in dust and rubble as people screamed and ran in the street. A hospital in the district of Ende in East Nusa Tenggara Province was moving patients outside, Kompas TV footage showed. logs.summary:
The death toll from the M7.7 earthquake in Flores, Indonesia has risen to 103, with the highest fatalities in Manggarai (41) and East Manggarai (34). The Health Ministry has established field hospitals at Ruteng and Aeramo to support medical services, while the West Papua community raised Rp167.6 million for earthquake victims.
As of August 26-27, the death toll from the M7.7 earthquake has risen to at least 105, with nearly 180,000 people displaced and over 7,700 aftershocks recorded. President Prabowo visited the affected region 11 days after the quake, distributing Rp20 billion in aid per district, while Telkom Indonesia restored all telecom services in the area.
